author: Scopoli, 1786

months.note: 늦게 번식한 무리는 8월 중순에도 알을 품는다.

summary: 저수지나 가시연꽃이 빽빽하게 자라는 물에 사는 새로, 긴 목과 긴 꼬리, 긴 발가락이 눈에 띈다. 분포권 북쪽에서 번식하는 무리는 남쪽으로 옮겨 가지만, 남쪽에서 번식하는 무리는 한곳에 머무는 텃새이다. 중국 양쯔 강 이남과 일본 규슈(후쿠오카)에 분포한다.

points.en: white face, throat, foreneck and upper breast
white upper part of the folded wing
long tail and very long toes

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같고 암컷이 수컷보다 크다.

young: 겨울깃 어른새와 비슷하나 머리 위가 적갈색을 띠고 목 옆에 노란색이 없으며 가슴의 검은 띠가 흐리다. 등과 어깨깃에는 넓은 담황색 깃 가장자리가 있다.

art.subject: Pheasant-tailed Jacana (Hydrophasianus chirurgus), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean reservoirs from June to September: face, chin, throat and foreneck white; a black patch on the hindcrown and a black line running from it down the side of the neck, separating the white foreneck from the glossy golden-yellow hindneck; body, back, lower breast and belly chocolate-blackish; folded wings almost wholly white, with black tips to the outer primaries; very long, decurved black tail plumes. Slender bluish-grey bill; dark eye; long grey-green legs with extremely long toes and claws.
art.pose: standing on floating leaves, side view
art.scene: Korean reservoir thickly covered with floating prickly water-lily leaves; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing on floating water-lily leaves: white face, throat and foreneck, black hindcrown and neck-side line, golden-yellow hindneck, chocolate-black body, white folded wings, very long drooping black tail, very long toes spread over the leaf
adult, wing detail: mostly white folded wing above the dark flank, outer primaries black-tipped and drawn out into slender elongated points
art.build: Slender, elegant waterbird; the body is smaller than a Common Moorhen's, but in breeding plumage the very long, drooping tail more than doubles its length. Small head on a long thin neck. Bill short, slender and straight, shorter than the head. Legs long, with extraordinarily long toes and straight claws that spread its weight over floating leaves. The outer primaries end in thin, drawn-out pointed tips. In flight mostly white wings with black tips, dark body and long trailing tail.
avoid: Do not paint short toes or webbed feet; the toes are extremely long and thin.
Do not paint a short tail on a breeding bird; the tail plumes are very long.
Do not paint a red frontal shield like a moorhen or a long wading bill.
Do not paint dark wings; the folded wings and most of the open wing are white.
